in_sanskrit.name: राहुल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Rahul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rahu' which means 'friend' or 'companion'. The suffix 'ul' is added to form the name, which can be interpreted as 'pathfinder' or 'one who leads the way'. This name is often given to children who are expected to be good companions and guides in life.

in_hindi.name: राहुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Rahul is composed of two syllables in Hindi: 'Ra' and 'hul'. The first syllable, 'Ra', is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rahu' which means 'friend' or 'companion'. The second syllable, 'hul', is of uncertain origin and may not have any specific meaning in Hinduism.

in_tamil.name: ராஹுல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Rahul is written as 'ராஹுல்' (Rāhul). The meaning of the name in Tamil is 'கோழியன்' (Kožiyāṉ), which can be translated to 'companion' or 'friend'.

in_telugu.name: రాహుల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Rahul is written as 'రాహుల్' (Rāhul). The meaning of the name in Telugu is 'శద్దళ' (Shaddaḷu), which can be translated to 'close friend' or 'dear one'.
